Dive the Data

Connecting divers with marine research

Explore the work

ProjectsResearchExpeditionsDiscuss a project

I co-founded and designed Dive the Data, a citizen science platform for recording and exploring marine megafauna sightings.

Period: 2019–2021.

My contribution: co-founding, platform and dashboard design, and training dive-center teams.

The idea

Dive the Data gave dive-center teams a way to record and explore sightings. The work connected a data collection platform with the practical task of helping people contribute observations.

Designing for participation

I designed dashboards and trained teams across five global regions to collect and upload sightings data.

What the work involved

The platform and the training were parts of the same undertaking: creating a way to contribute data and helping teams understand how to use it.

Related field experience

Marine Megafauna Foundation in Mozambique: research dives and marine megafauna field data collection.
